replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. My low neuroticism score means I stay calm even with tricky problems. When I’m stuck, I break tasks into small steps—like solving a budget problem or adjusting recipes—so anxiety doesn’t build up.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes! I used an AI tool to check my budget calculations and solve simple algebra problems. It was helpful for quick verification but not for deep learning. I’d recommend it for basic checks but not for mastering complex topics.
